64.rule: smallest lag with ACF(d) < 0.1 = 6, rounded up to a power of 2

256.rule: smallest lag with ACF(d) < 0.1 = 12, rounded up to a power of 2

1024.rule: smallest lag with ACF(d) < 0.1 = 13, rounded up to a power of 2

4096.rule: smallest lag with ACF(d) < 0.1 = 12, rounded up to a power of 2

legacy.rule: smallest lag with ACF(d) < 0.1 = 7, rounded up to a power of 2
